recognize_zh: A、B 格中嗜中性球細胞質空泡內有多個卵圓至香腸狀的小酵母體，D、E 格的嗜中性球核分葉異常（核葉分離、未分節），F 格為分枝菌絲，組合起來指向 HIV 患者血液中的馬爾尼菲籃狀菌（Talaromyces marneffei）感染合併發育不良嗜中性球。
features: Panels A-B: neutrophils with cytoplasmic vacuoles containing multiple small oval to elongated yeast-like organisms with clear halos
Panel C: large mononuclear phagocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and an adjacent cluster of organisms
Panel D: neutrophil with abnormally separated, rounded nuclear lobes (nuclear fragmentation/abnormal segmentation)
Panel E: neutrophil with a non-segmented, elongated dumbbell-shaped nucleus and a small detached nuclear fragment (dysplastic/pseudo-Pelger-like)
Panel F: dense tangle of dark branching septate hyphae on a red background, representing the mould phase
Transverse septa of individual yeasts are suggested but not clearly resolved at this resolution
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils containing intracytoplasmic vacuoles filled with small oval to elongated yeast-like organisms, as well as a mononuclear phagocyte associated with a cluster of similar organisms. Several neutrophils display dysplastic nuclear features, including abnormally separated lobes and a hyposegmented dumbbell-shaped nucleus. A separate panel shows branching hyphae of the mould phase. In a patient with newly diagnosed HIV infection, findings are consistent with disseminated Talaromyces marneffei infection with dysplastic neutrophils; culture confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller, uniformly oval and reproduce by narrow-based budding, whereas T. marneffei forms include elongated sausage shapes dividing by a central transverse septum; culture at 25 C showing red diffusible pigment identifies Talaromyces.
Candida yeasts are larger, show budding and pseudohyphae in blood smears, and lack the septate fission forms.
Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a rod-like kinetoplast and is mainly seen in macrophages rather than neutrophils.
Dysplastic neutrophils in HIV and sepsis can mimic MDS, but MDS requires persistent cytopenias, multilineage dysplasia in the marrow and exclusion of infection or drugs.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; panel F culture prep (stain NS)
